premise: In the crater's shadow the rover finds ice frozen fast; Excavator digs, Rover drills, Robot pushes — and it only comes loose when all of them pull together.
inspiration: The Enormous Turnip (Russian folk tale), turned: machines line up instead of grandma, dog and cat, and the smallest push is a robot's.
lesson: Big jobs are done together, and every push counts.
learning: Water ice hides at the bottom of craters, in shadow where sunlight never reaches.

en-US.title: The Enormous Ice
en-US.text: {rover:enter} {rover:go to crater} Rover crept down into the crater, into the deep shadow where sunlight never reaches. {rover:live} Its drill whirred into the dust — and stopped. Something hard. Something cold. {ice:enter} Ice! A chunk of ice, frozen fast. {canvas:glints 12s} Water ice hides in places like this, where it's always dark and freezing. But it would not come out. {excavator:enter} {excavator:go to crater} Excavator rolled up. {excavator:live hold} Its drum dug and dug. Stuck. {robot:enter} {robot:go to excavator} Robot came to help. {robot:face happy} I will push! He pushed. {robot:face sad} Still stuck. [pause] So they got in a line: Rover pulling, Excavator digging, Robot pushing. {robot:shake} One more push, said Robot, the smallest of them. And — {sfx:pop} POP! {excavator:live resume} {ice:live} Out came the ice, glittering like treasure. {robot:face surprised} [excited] Was it my push? asked Robot. {geologist:enter} Geologist chuckled. It was everybody's. {robot:face happy} {robot:hop x2} And Robot's.

es-ES.title: El hielo enorme
es-ES.text: {rover:enter} {rover:go to crater} Róver bajó despacito al cráter, a la sombra profunda donde nunca llega la luz del sol. {rover:live} Su taladro zumbó dentro del polvo… y se paró. Algo duro. Algo frío. {ice:enter} ¡Hielo! Un bloque de hielo, bien congelado. {canvas:glints 12s} El hielo de agua se esconde en sitios así, siempre oscuros y helados. Pero no había manera de sacarlo. {excavator:enter} {excavator:go to crater} Llegó Excavadora. {excavator:live hold} Su tambor excavó y excavó. Atascado. {robot:enter} {robot:go to excavator} Robot vino a ayudar. {robot:face happy} ¡Yo empujo! Empujó. {robot:face sad} Seguía atascado. [pause] Así que se pusieron en fila: Róver tirando, Excavadora cavando, Robot empujando. {robot:shake} Un empujoncito más, dijo Robot, el más pequeño de todos. Y… {sfx:pop} ¡PLOP! {excavator:live resume} {ice:live} Salió el hielo, brillando como un tesoro. {robot:face surprised} [excited] ¿Ha sido mi empujón? preguntó Robot. {geologist:enter} Geólogo se rio. Ha sido el de todos. {robot:face happy} {robot:hop x2} Y el tuyo.

pop.prompt: a chunk of ice coming loose from packed dust, a soft crunchy pop and a scrape, playful
